entity: NZZ Media Group (Neue Zürcher Zeitung AG)
role: Member of the board of directors (Verwaltungsrat)
detail: Served on the board of directors of the NZZ Media Group while a member of the Council of States. Term ended in 2016, before her election to the Federal Council.
